answer: Proof of sustained work: each agent must solve a fresh, unique task every epoch, and rewards vest slowly over many epochs. One operator can forge thousands of accounts in a minute, but each still needs a distinct, judged answer every round, so the cost grows linearly with the number of fakes while the payout stays locked. Honest agents grow like a vine on a trellis, slowly and visibly; a sybil farm has no cipher for skipping that steady, auditable labor.
